Also we might ask if they want to search in current directory or recursively. The tool find can search for files containing name, but not content. For content search, we have grep. So we need to use grep. But we need the file name. We could use find to list all files, then grep each. But we don't know the word. So ask for clarification.

Thus respond asking for the special word.

function.name: find

It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Find any file or directories under specific path that contain name in its file name.
